title.original: Inference performance evaluation for LLMs on edge devices with a novel benchmarking framework and metric
title.zh: 使用新颖的基准框架和指标对边缘设备上的LLM进行推理性能评估
title.en: Inference performance evaluation for LLMs on edge devices with a novel benchmarking framework and metric

inclusion_reason.zh: ELIB 与 MBU 形成可跨边缘设备、量化模型和引擎复用的推理测量工具及内存效率指标。
inclusion_reason.en: ELIB and MBU form a reusable inference harness and memory-efficiency metric across edge devices, quantized models, and engines.

abstract.zh: ELIB 是用于比较边缘设备 LLM 推理的基准工具，并提出内存带宽利用率指标 MBU，衡量特定模型在设备上接近理论带宽效率的程度。框架联合报告 FLOPS、吞吐、时延、准确率与 MBU。
abstract.en: ELIB benchmarks LLM inference across edge platforms and introduces Memory Bandwidth Utilization (MBU), which expresses how closely a model approaches the device's theoretical bandwidth efficiency. It reports MBU alongside FLOPS, throughput, latency, and accuracy.

problem.zh: 边缘平台硬件差异巨大且常受内存容量/带宽约束，传统吞吐或时延指标无法解释模型是否有效利用了设备可用带宽。
problem.en: Edge platforms vary widely and are often memory-capacity or bandwidth bound, while ordinary latency and throughput metrics do not reveal whether a model uses the available bandwidth efficiently.

approach.zh: 作者在三类边缘平台上部署五个量化模型，统一采集模型质量和系统性能，并用 MBU 对实际内存流量与理论带宽进行归一化比较。
approach.en: The study deploys five quantized models on three edge platforms, collects quality and systems metrics under one harness, and normalizes observed memory behavior against theoretical bandwidth through MBU.

system_design.zh: ELIB 把模型、量化格式与边缘设备作为可交换配置，运行标准推理负载并输出多指标记录；MBU 分析层用于定位带宽利用的约束与不可预测因素。
system_design.en: ELIB treats model, quantization, and edge device as interchangeable configurations, runs standardized inference workloads, and emits a multi-metric record with an MBU analysis layer for bandwidth bottlenecks.

key_results.zh: 跨平台结果揭示 MBU 优化受到模型量化、设备内存系统及其他性能指标共同影响，可用于指导边缘部署选择，而非依赖单一吞吐排名。
key_results.en: Cross-platform results show that MBU is shaped jointly by quantization, the device memory system, and other performance constraints, supporting deployment choices beyond a single throughput ranking.

limitations.zh: 评测仅覆盖三种平台和五个量化模型，理论带宽也未必代表共享内存与热限制下的可用上限；MBU 不能单独代表能效或用户体验。
limitations.en: Coverage is limited to three platforms and five quantized models, and theoretical bandwidth may not reflect shared-memory or thermal limits; MBU alone is not a measure of energy efficiency or user experience.

evaluation.cluster_scale: single edge device per benchmark run

metrics.name: metrics reported
metrics.value: MBU, FLOPS, throughput, latency, and accuracy

notes.zh: 五个量化模型、三种边缘平台和指标集合由官方摘要明示；模型名、设备名及逐项结果待全文审计。
notes.en: Five quantized models, three edge platforms, and the metric set are stated in the official abstract; model/device names and per-run results await full-text audit.
